definitions.gloss: income and expenses; revenue and expenditure; balance
definitions.explanation: the combined consideration of money coming in (income) and money going out (expenses); used to discuss financial balance

examples.japanese: {収支|しゅうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収支|しゅうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧だった。
examples.english: This month's balance was in the red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{収支|しゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm keeping a record of our household income and expenses.

notes:
FORMS:
{収|しゅう} (income, taking in) + {支|し} (expenditure, paying out) → income and outflow

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {収支|しゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to break even)
- {収支|しゅうし}⟦トントン→トントン：11022_tonton⟧ (breaking even, neither profit nor loss)
- {収支|しゅうし}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (financial report)
- {収支|しゅうし}⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (balance of accounts)

TYPES:
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{収支|しゅうし} (annual balance)
- ⟦{月間|げっかん}→月間：13077_gekkan⟧{収支|しゅうし} (monthly balance)
- ⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧{収支|しゅうし} (trade balance)
- {経常|けいじょう}{収支|しゅうし} (current account balance)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧ (income)
- ⟦{支出|ししゅつ}→支出：03169_shishutsu⟧ (expenditure)
- ⟦{黒字|くろじ}→黒字：04715_kuroji⟧ (profit, in the black)
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧ (deficit, in the red)
